meta.design: jobs the graph decides to bid on, not scam or injected, ordered by sha256, first N; arm = sha256(x2:job_id) parity; one strategy per job
meta.caveat: GigSim reply draws are pseudo random per proposal id, so n near 30 per arm can only detect large differences (see min_detectable_diff_80pct_power)

diagnostic_expected_reply_prob.note: simulator internal probability, not observable in the real world
